name: Canned Quartered Artichoke Hearts (In Water, Well-Rinsed)
whyItWorks: Tender, soft inner artichoke hearts packed in water and sea salt. Unlike spiny outer whole artichoke leaves which can lodge in strictures, the canned heart is soft and chewable when rinsed.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain and rinse hearts thoroughly under cold water. Inspect each piece and discard any stray tough outer leaf layers before tossing into salads or warm dishes.
